subject: 江南民居
prompt: Use case: historical-scene. Asset type: a single RGBA building sprite for a realistic historical Chinese isometric town map. Year 1223 CE, Southern Song Lin'an/Jiangnan. Render realistic weathered wood, handmade grey tiles, natural stone and plaster, muted warm earthy tones, sophisticated historical game environment, not cartoon. Camera MUST be exact orthographic yaw 45 degrees, elevation pitch 30 degrees; 2:1 diamond ground grid with ground edges at slopes +0.5 and -0.5; no perspective convergence. Local south-facing entrance appears on screen lower-left facing wall. Single isolated complete building module over a thin flat rectangular ground footprint, no thick diorama plinth, ground footprint edges clearly visible. Main light comes from screen upper left, short soft contact shadow toward lower right only. True transparent background alpha; no white background, no checkerboard texture, no sky or surroundings. Center entire silhouette with minimum 10 percent transparent margin on EVERY side. Full eaves and base within image. No people, no characters, no readable writing, no signage text, no watermark, no modern objects, no Qing/Ming palace fashions, no excessive fantasy curls. Footprint dimensions relate to planning ground, not total roof height. Footprint exactly 6 by 5 one-metre cells, ratio 6:5. Subject: One compact single-storey Southern Song Jiangnan family dwelling, limewashed plaster walls, dark timber posts, grey clay tile gable roof with restrained curved eaves, small wooden lattice windows, modest recessed doorway on southwest-facing visible side, a plain ceramic water jar.
negative: 文字、标牌字、水印、人物、天空、地平线、背景色、棋盘格、厚地台、大阴影、现代物、清代形制、透视消失点、裁切屋檐、卡通。

paste without mask into transparent RGBA canvas; no repaint, warp, flip or alpha thresholding
